Read complete required unit, Lean-selection and policy inputs from the immutable bundles and the listed supporting snapshots, then compared semantic assumptions, operations, notation and example coverage.
rationale: readPath distinguishes failed lookup (none) from a final empty slot (some none), verifies the root object at epsilon, and requires an occupied and existing intermediate object before continuing. A final occupied slot returns its identity; allocation and declared class of positive results are separately required by Satisfies. Satisfies checks root nominal class, every positive finite path against both readPath and classAt with allocated target data, and every negative path against a defined empty slot. It imposes no local condition on omitted branches. Realizes requires well-formed class/environment descriptions and admissible pending types, matching the chapter-wide static domains. WellFormedWith uses pending.map Prod.fst plus every stored reference, requiring unique ownership occurrences and exact completeness over allocated identities, with the specified shapes, bounds and age ordering. FieldsMatchClasses quantifies over every occupied field in every object, including fields hidden by views. variableDomain is extensional equality of variable-name domains; emptyVariables/initializedVariables match each description, including allocated empty slots. pendingValues requires every pending pair to satisfy its type. Nothing requires all allocated objects to satisfy their whole classes. The required dependency units introduce class/field/variable names and expressions (given.classes, given.syntax), finite maps and sequences (given.programs), typed class tables (given.typing.declarations), signed paths and value types (given.typing.views), positive/negative observations (given.typing.observations), and normalized focus/emptying before these are used. The relevant complete authored units and exact Lean selections, including transitive dependencies, were compared; no unresolved notation needed for this comparison was found.
limitations: This is a fresh correspondence inspection of definitions and example propositions, not a Lean proof audit or a report of mechanical test execution. General normalization correctness and static progress/preservation remain unproved draft claims; no such theorem is assumed here.
Additional listed source snapshots were read for supporting definitions and example setups; unrelated conservative snapshots and validator implementation are not claimed to have been audited.
